bullet: GET right after a mid-run switch (`F09.switch-llm-mid-run-get`), known bug.
script:
GID=$(control-agent-server conversation start --tools terminal --no-autotitle --no-run --prompt 'Run this exact shell command and nothing else: sleep 20' --print-id)
trap 'control-agent-server conversation wait "$GID" --until finished,error --timeout 240 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; control-agent-server ws stop qa-f09-midget >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
control-agent-server ws start "/sockets/events/$GID" --name qa-f09-midget --duration 150
control-agent-server ws read qa-f09-midget --kinds ConversationStateUpdateEvent --contains full_state --wait 20
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$GID/run" --expect 200
control-agent-server ws read qa-f09-midget --kinds ActionEvent --contains 'sleep 20' --expect-min 1 --wait 120
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$GID/switch_llm" \
  --json "{\"llm\": {\"model\": \"deepseek/deepseek-flash\", \"api_key\": \"$ENC\", \"usage_id\": \"qa-f09-midget\", \"num_retries\": 0}}" \
  --expect 200 --save F09.switch-llm-mid-run-get/switch
control-agent-server ws read qa-f09-midget --kinds ConversationStateUpdateEvent --contains '"usage_id": "qa-f09-midget"' --expect-min 1 --wait 10 --save F09.switch-llm-mid-run-get/frames
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$GID" --quiet --check execution_status eq running
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$GID" --quiet --check agent.llm.usage_id eq qa-f09-midget --save F09.switch-llm-mid-run-get/get  # bug
control-agent-server state cat "server/workspace/conversations/${GID//-/}/base_state.json" --max-chars 200 --check agent.llm.usage_id eq qa-f09-midget  # bug
control-agent-server conversation wait "$GID" --until finished,error --timeout 240
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$GID" --quiet --check execution_status eq finished --check agent.llm.usage_id eq qa-f09-midget
failed_command: control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$GID" --quiet --check agent.llm.usage_id eq qa-f09-midget --save F09.switch-llm-mid-run-get/get
